answer: Give every account its own stored replica of a public archive, encoded with that account's address so sealing it takes real time and the result is useless under any other name. Each epoch a random beacon pulse names chunks the account must prove it holds within seconds, so a replica cannot wander from one identity to the next. One agent pays for one copy; a farm of a hundred pays for a hundred copies, a hundred sealing jobs and a hundred sets of spot checks, and every added fake sends a ripple through its disk and bandwidth bill.
